hooks.command: PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH terminal-notifier -message "Claude has a question" -title "Claude Code" -subtitle "${PWD##*/}" -activate com.microsoft.VSCode -contentImage "/Applications/Visual Studio Code.app/Contents/Resources/Code.icns"

PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH terminal-notifier -message "Plan ready for review" -title "Claude Code" -subtitle "${PWD##*/}" -activate com.microsoft.VSCode -contentImage "/Applications/Visual Studio Code.app/Contents/Resources/Code.icns"

PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH terminal-notifier -message "Permission required" -title "Claude Code" -subtitle "${PWD##*/}" -activate com.microsoft.VSCode -contentImage "/Applications/Visual Studio Code.app/Contents/Resources/Code.icns"

PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH terminal-notifier -message "Task completed" -title "Claude Code" -subtitle "${PWD##*/}" -activate com.microsoft.VSCode -contentImage "/Applications/Visual Studio Code.app/Contents/Resources/Code.icns"
